calls.reason: Anthropic's 17% Claude Code limit cut and OpenAI's announced Pro cut fit the claim. But OpenAI reversed its cut, and nothing covers Google or GitHub. An open-ended universal guarantee isn't settled.
Microsoft discloses only a $37B annualised AI revenue rate and quarterly company-wide capex. Nothing gives realised AI revenue excluding OpenAI or AI-specific cumulative capex.

CNBC confirms the $65B run rate, and the S-1's $16.3B first-half revenue is close. But operating loss was only $693M, while the $80.7B net loss came mostly from fair-value changes, so 'losing billions' is unclear.

Higher Nvidia server prices and one month of wider Nvidia CDS spreads fit the claim. Heavy bond oversubscription and flat service list prices cut against it. Nothing measures lab spending or impatience.

The only counterevidence is Gamma's CEO calling the company profitable in an interview. It is self-reported, with no defined measure or accounts for the period, so the universal 'none' is neither clearly confirmed nor refuted.
